author: Michael Larabel
description: As part of this week's block subsystem fixes for the Linux 7.4-rc4 kernel release due out on Sunday are many bug fixes plus also a nice NVMe namespaces optimization...
title: Linux 7.4 To Remove NVMe Namespaces In Parallel For Faster Results

author: Michael Larabel
description: The Google-developed Sashiko for agentic AI code review initially focused on the Linux kernel continues helping to uncover new bugs and issues as new patches hit the kernel mailing list as well as those manually running this open-source AI software. In addition to recently introducing an experimental patch series design assessment, they are introducing another new skill for helping with performance/benchmark evaluation of kernel changes...
title: Sashiko AI Introducing Linux Performance Specialist Review Stage

author: Michael Larabel
description: Since last year there have been Linux patches for enabling the Intel Nova Lake NPU with its 6th Gen neural processing unit IP. Those patches were since mainlined with the Intel IVPU accelerator driver. Now the user-space Intel Linux NPU Driver was updated on Thursday with official Nova Lake support...
title: Intel Linux NPU Driver 1.39.1 Released With Nova Lake Support

author: Michael Larabel
description: Debian 13.8 is out today as the newest ISO refresh for Debian 13 "Trixie" with 150 security updates noted along with many bug fixes...
title: Debian 13.8 Released With 150+ Security Updates

author: Michael Larabel
description: It has been another busy week in the KDE development space with more feature work and fixes piling up for the upcoming Plasma 6.9 desktop...
title: KDE Plasma 6.9 Allows Adjusting The Text Cursor Blinking Rate, Other Improvements

author: Michael Larabel
description: FreeDesktop.org has been the hosting hub for the X.Org project, Wayland, and the Mesa projects to other notable open-source Linux desktop projects like PipeWire, GStreamer, and countless other projects. Since it's launch over two decades ago, it has basically looked the same... A bland Wiki. But on Friday a redesign of FreeDesktop.org was launched...
title: FreeDesktop.org Launches Redesigned Website

author: Michael Larabel
description: The third weekly beta release of FreeBSD 15.2 is now available for testing. This comes with various bug fixes, updated OpenZFS code, and fixes for 17 FreeBSD security advisories that were made public this week...
title: FreeBSD 15.2 Beta 3 Released Following 17 Security Advisories
